chapter_title_en: Human Meat and the Shifting Map
chapter_seo_title: Dao Twisted World Ch 406: Human Meat Dinner & The Map That Changed Reality
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang discovers the lamb is human meat, slaughters a black inn, and finds that his map has rewritten itself to match a new reality—the Great Qi.
og_title: Human Meat and the Truth That Rewrites Maps
og_description: A black inn, a plate of human flesh, and a map that forgot the old capital—Li Huowang faces a world that has quietly changed around him.
twitter_title: Li Huowang eats human meat, throws up, and discovers the world has been rewritten
twitter_description: The Great Liang is gone. The map says Great Qi. And nobody told Li Huowang.

lore_anchors.definition: A government agency in the Great Qi that monitors and polices supernatural activity; its agents are jaded professionals who have seen many horrors, but Li Huowang’s tentacle display shocks even them.
A being whose ability can rewrite reality on a massive scale; the Great Liang was replaced by the Great Qi through such a power.
The capital city of the Great Qi, now the political center of the Dao-Twisted World instead of the former Upper Capital.
The parasitic entity inside Li Huowang that has begun to exhibit child-like behavior; it now asks for weapons and playthings.
A large, heavy blade often associated with executioners and bandits in Chinese wuxia and folk horror.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Li Huowang’s map change?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Heart-Pan’s ability rewrote reality so that the Great Liang became the Great Qi. The map, being a physical record of the old world, was overwritten to match the new truth.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Li Sui becoming more human?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She is developing awareness and personality, mimicking child-like behavior she observes from Li Huowang and those around him. She is a parasitic entity learning to be a person.
It is the Zuowandao’s core doctrine—the ability to make lies, illusions, and falsehoods become physically real through concentrated belief and effort.
